properties.notes: This brownfield site is part of a larger site that includes greenfield land. The minimum net dwellings figure of 6 relates only to the brownfield part of this site, the whole site, including the greenfield part, has a permission for 8 dwellings (RR/2016/2430/P - Proposed demolition of two existing large dwelling houses and construction of eight 2 bedroom apartments and two 3 bedroom apartments across two blocks with associated parking and landscaping). December 2020 - permission just lapsed. An end date will be added to this site in 2022 unless the circumstances concerning the site change.
